description: Intrusion-detection events: data source 2. Several providers may be active at once; every event names the provider that reported it, and the kind keeps a watermark per file.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called before every read: which of the feed's files still exist, so a lost file is recorded as a permanent gap.
functions.name: rotation

functions.description: Called at every security-event pass: the newest page_size events, newest first.
functions.name: alerts

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: Whether the files could be listed; false declares nothing lost.
fields.name: known

fields.description: The file identifiers the feed still carries.
fields.name: present

fields.description: The current file's sequence, when the feed reports one.
fields.name: highest_sequence

fields.description: Why the listing failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: The `security_event_alert` records read, absent when the read failed.
fields.name: alerts

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did; the result then says what the firewall answered.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why this implementation's material can never be read, when that is so: a state, recorded with its reason, and not a failure.
fields.name: unsupported

fields.description: The file the event was read from; with byte_offset, the coordinate the watermark keeps.
fields.name: file_id

fields.description: Where in the file.
fields.name: byte_offset

fields.description: When the event happened.
fields.name: occurred_at

fields.description: The rule or signature's identifier.
fields.name: rule_identity

fields.description: The signature's text; empty when the event carries none.
fields.name: signature

fields.description: What the engine did.
fields.name: event_action

fields.description: The severity, when the event carries one.
fields.name: normalised_severity

fields.description: The source address.
fields.name: src_address

fields.description: The destination address.
fields.name: dst_address

fields.description: The source port, 0 to 65535.
fields.name: src_port

fields.description: The destination port, 0 to 65535.
fields.name: dst_port

fields.description: The protocol.
fields.name: protocol

fields.description: The device the event was seen on.
fields.name: in_interface_device
